title: fix(pm): board-snapshot counts a redirect with no Location as a transfer, not unreadable
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x6rDP1LW23RxDDdzXpJsbPW)_

Fixes #32047

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 无。普通队列落地，由 skills 席位审核(`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测为非受管路径)。
问题：定时 `Fleet Patrols` 的数量核对每次多出 2 条(SURPLUS of 2)，就是 11-09 转到私有 cloud 仓的 #31781、#31782。
原因：工作流的 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 读不到 cloud，GitHub 回 301 时 `Location` 为空，脚本把它当成 `unreadable`。
修法：只改 `numberReadVerdict`。重定向没有 `Location`(空或缺失)时，记为“转到本令牌读不到的仓库”，按转仓计数。
不变：`Location` 指向本仓(改名)或解析不了的，仍记 `unreadable`；404/410 仍是销毁信号。`gone.json` 不动。
自测 200 → 205 例；下一次定时巡检应转绿，以后再转卡到私有仓也不会变红。

## Step 0: what the read of #31781 returns

The failing job (run 42742022850, job 129585145760) logs only the verdict, not the `Location`:

```
reconcile    the first census disagreed (SURPLUS of 2: archived 221, board 157)
             unreadable:     #31781 (HTTP 301), #31782 (HTTP 301)
count check  SURPLUS of 2
```

The step runs with `GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}` (`.github/workflows/fleet-patrols.yml`), the workflow's own token, which is scoped to this repository. I could not use that token, so this is **not** CI's own read. I reproduced the read on 2026-11-10T03:11Z with **this session's GitHub token** (the Claude GitHub App user token behind the session proxy). That token reads `objectstack-ai/objectstack` and `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` and **cannot** read `objectstack-ai/cloud`, so it stands where CI's token stands with respect to the private target.

```
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/31781   (redirect not followed)
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Content-Length: 153
Location:
X-Github-Request-Id: 200B:26F741:4D75341:FCCEED7:6AF28B71

{"message":"Moved Permanently","url":"","documentation_url":"https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api#follow-redirects"}
```

`#31782` answers the same: `301`, an empty `Location`, and `"url":""`. For comparison, `#25896`, `#25769`, `#26958`, `#27235` and `#28788` moved to `hotcrm`, which this token can read, and their redirects resolve normally. The card records that a maintainer token that can read cloud gets `Location: https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/cloud/issues/4163`.

Caveat: the session proxy blocks cloud, so I cannot fully rule out that the proxy, not GitHub, blanked the header. The reply carries GitHub's own `X-Github-Request-Id` and a GitHub-shaped body with `"url":""`, which a header rewrite would not produce, so I read it as GitHub's answer. CI's verdict line agrees: a non-empty `/repos/objectstack-ai/cloud/...` Location would have matched the old pattern and read `transferred`.

**CI returns no target at all.** So there is no `/repositories/{id}/issues/{n}` form to parse, and none was added.

## The inference, stated as one

A redirect with an empty or missing `Location` names no repository. Counting it as a move out of this repository rests on two facts:

1. GitHub blanks the target only when the token cannot read it. This is measured for the transfer side, as above.
2. The same reconcile has just read **this** repository's open listing with the same token.

So the target is not this repository. A rename of this repository would carry a readable `Location` that names this repository, and that case stays `unreadable`. **The rename side is not measured**, because no renamed repository was available to read. The docblock (§ A listing that lags) says the same.

## Verdict table (`numberReadVerdict`, redirect statuses 301/302/307/308)

| `Location` | Old | New |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `…/repos/{other}/issues/{n}` (another repository) | `transferred`, `to: other#n` | unchanged |
| `…/repos/{this}/issues/{n}` (same repository, a rename) | `unreadable` | unchanged |
| empty string (the #31781 reply) | `unreadable` | **`transferred`**, `to: 'a repository this token cannot read'`, `status` |
| absent (`null`) | `unreadable` | **`transferred`**, same as the empty string |
| present but not parseable (e.g. `…/repositories/1/issues/7`, `not a url`) | `unreadable` | unchanged |

200, 404, 410 and every other status are unchanged.

The record keeps `transferred_to: 'a repository this token cannot read'`. The census counts any truthy `transferred_to` apart from the open set, and the run summary prints `#31781 → a repository this token cannot read`. Nothing reads `to` as `owner/name#n`: the only consumers are the census, which checks truthiness, and the summary line, which prints the value.

## Self-test

`node scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs --self-test`: **200 → 205 cases**, 14 batteries. The floor of the battery `the lagging listing and the moved card` goes from 31 to 36.

- **Changed case.** `…a redirect within THIS repository (a rename) is not a transfer` used to assert that `{ status: 301, location: null }` was `unreadable`. The card's rule changes that, so that conjunct moves to a new case that asserts `transferred`. The same-repository `Location` conjunct is kept as it was.
- **New, unit:**
  - An empty `Location` (the #31781 reply) is `transferred` and carries `status: 301`.
  - No `Location` is `transferred` for 301, 302, 307 and 308.
  - A present, unparseable `Location` stays `unreadable`.
- **New, end to end** through `snapshot()` with the fake board:
  - Setup: a `movedHidden` option makes the fake board answer `301` with an empty `Location`. Two cards moved to a private repository then reproduce the patrol red: the first census reads SURPLUS 2.
  - The reconcile records both as transferred, the count check reads `ok`, and the run exits 0.
  - The records stay whole with `transferred_to` set and are counted apart from the open set.
- **Ablation.** With the new branch disabled, 4 of 205 cases fail: the two unit cases and the two end-to-end cases.

## Gates

On head `f3ad67ec`, with exit codes in `/mnt/project-files/card-32047/gates-f3ad67ec.txt` (project file). The run covers `dispatch-gates --commands`, which lists 38 commands including `board-snapshot.mjs --self-test` and `check:pm-board-snapshot`, plus `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`. All 39 exit 0.

Landing: `check-governed-merges.mjs --test scripts/pm/board-snapshot.mjs` reads NOT governed, so this lands through the ordinary queue on the lane seat's review. No new gate, row or workflow step. `board/gone.json` on `board-archive` is untouched.

Contract-review tier: `dispatch-gates --tier` reads no path mandate, so the build runs at the default tier. Under the maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03, card threads do not run at the mandated contract-review tier themselves. The seat runs the contract review of record.

Changeset: `skip-changeset`, because nothing publishes.
